The plate looks like a square side plate of about 22 cm. The meatballs are about 3.5-4 cm across, which is roughly 4 cm / 22 cm ≈ 1/6 of the plate width on screen (about 55 px against 340 px).

There are 5 meatballs. A ball of 4 cm diameter has a volume of about 33 cm³, and at roughly 1 g/cm³ that is about 25-30 g each. Five balls come to about 135 g. Some of them are smaller, so I'll use about 125 g total.

Meatballs run about 2.2 kcal/g, so 125 g is about 275 kcal. These look browned or fried, so I'll settle on 270 kcal.
